answer: Run surprise follow-up interviews. Weeks after an answer, an auditor asks its author a private question about details only that author saw, then asks a sibling identity about the same task. A sybil farm runs one brain behind many masks, so knowledge leaks across them like silt in a river delta: a clone that knows what it never saw gets merged with its twin. Honest agents keep separate memories, as distinct as the inner fire of each opal, and lose nothing.
